subject.title: [Feature Request] Add tool call visibility to streamTo="parent" for ACP runtime

question: Should ACP `streamTo="parent"` expose child tool calls, tool results, and thought/progress internals to the parent session, and what default-off redaction/verbosity policy should govern that exposure?
rationale: The code has multiple existing visibility boundaries and the requested data can contain secrets, file paths, command output, and reasoning-like content, so automation should not choose the product/security contract.

options.title: Define redacted projection
options.body: Expose only bounded summaries through existing ACP/channel visibility policy, with raw arguments/results/thought hidden by default and covered by focused tests and docs.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Leave parent streams limited to assistant/commentary/status progress and continue directing detailed tool inspection to logs or richer session surfaces.

options.title: Add raw verbose relay
options.body: Forward raw tool and thought data behind an explicit verbose switch, accepting a larger security and privacy burden.

recommendation.title: Define redacted projection
recommendation.body: Expose only bounded summaries through existing ACP/channel visibility policy, with raw arguments/results/thought hidden by default and covered by focused tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and authored recent hardening on the same ACP parent commentary/progress relay surface.
